summary: All four v1 fixes land: 'erg bang' (L1 must_fix), 'je kent de sceptische literatuur niet' (L2), 'tegen ze gezegd' (L3) and the 12-word 'Haar magie kon ik niet krijgen, maar …' coordination (L4) are plain, natural Dutch inside the profile. The changed blocks introduce no new grammar, vocabulary or naturalness problem; the single parser flag is the same false positive as in v1. One should_fix: exceptions.json now says 'fluisteren' is never glossed, so the \gl on 'fluisterde' in b018 is gloss bloat and should go. Eight v1 notes carried, one dropped (no gloss clusters reported any more), one new dismissal note for the per-token vocabulary rows.

previous_findings.note: 'hij was maar al te bang' → 'hij was erg bang'; 'erg' known A1 'very'. The translator chose 'erg' over the suggested 'heel/echt' because bible.md lists those among intensifiers never to add; here the source has 'very much', so a plain intensifier is right. Accepted.
'je bent niet thuis in de sceptische literatuur' → 'je kent de sceptische literatuur niet'; 'kennen' known A1, exactly the suggested wording.
'Ik heb ze gezegd:' → 'Ik heb tegen ze gezegd:'; standard Dutch, suggested wording.
als/dan hypothetical → 'Haar magie kon ik niet krijgen, maar ik kon tenminste mooi zijn.' 12 words, A-INV + A-MODAL ×2 + A-COORD, no subordinate clause, no doubled 'dan'; suggested wording.
